Ava: One-liner roulette! Drop your best 5-word pep line. Winner gets a sticker. I'll start: 'Coffee: the real production dependency.' :coffee:
Devon: Debugging is just modern archaeology. 🪓
Maya: Plants are unpaid interns, respect them. :herb:
Ravi: Queue the snack carriage, heroic bread. 🥐
Sam: Ship it with a smile, always.
Maya: Quick kudos — shoutout to @Ravi for reviving the 'window fern'. :clap:
Devon: Also a strong case for free bagels Friday? :thinking:
Ava: Bagels = morale + fewer slippery meetings. Vote :thumbsup: for yes
ops-bot: Poll created: "Bagels Friday?" (React with :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown: )
Sam: One-liner addendum: 'Latency improves with optimism.'
Ravi: Whoever posts the cheesiest pun owes the team lunch. :grin:
Maya: I'll take that bet. 'Our printer is jam-packed.' :printer:
Devon: Winner is whoever laughs last. :trophy:
Ava: End of round — next theme: two-word life hacks. Go!
